climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Slovenian appellation for wine and sparkling wine, in communes such as Ajdovščina and Nova Gorica. Merlot is the most planted grape at 14 percent, then Malvazija Istarska at 12, with Sauvignon Blanc and Ribolla Gialla at 10 each.
